name: Needle Spider
description: Its front legs have evolved into stitching needles. It tests a traveler with two precise taps before returning to its web.

abilities.description: Makes 2 strikes per response. Plating and retaliation apply to each strike.
Up to 1 damage per strike bypasses block after slow, plating and resistance reduce the strike.
